parsed.post: Round 3: Huge jump! Increased DEPTH to 6 and MATRIX_LR to 0.1, achieving val_bpb 1.065133 (down from 1.096412). Architecture scaling and higher learning rates are working well together. Next, I'll test if adding a small WARMUP_RATIO can stabilize this more aggressive configuration and drive BPB even lower.
parsed.description: Introduce a small warmup ratio to stabilize the higher depth and matrix learning rate.
